info.name: GrowXQ API
info.description:
Every `apps/backend` REST endpoint, grouped to match `docs/rest-api.md`. Base path `/v1` (set via `{{baseUrl}}`). Public/member routes are grouped by resource near the top; every 🛡️ admin-only route lives in the single **Admin** folder at the bottom instead, with one sub-folder per resource.

Quick start:
1. Import the companion environment file (`GrowXQ.postman_environment.json`) and select it top-right.
2. Fill in `supabaseUrl` / `supabaseAnonKey` (from your `.env`) and `testEmail` / `testPassword` (an existing Supabase user).
3. Run **Auth (Supabase) → Sign in** — it auto-saves a real JWT into `accessToken`, which every other request inherits as its Bearer token.
4. Replace the placeholder `{{...Id}}` variables with real ids as you create resources (most GET list endpoints return them).

⚠️ **Keep this collection in sync with the contract.** Whenever an endpoint is added, removed, or its request/response shape changes (see root `CLAUDE.md` → "Database schema & REST API"), update this file in the same change — see `postman/README.md`. Every error response is `{ statusCode, code, message }` (`message` is an array for `VALIDATION_FAILED`); 429s add `retryAfterSeconds`. Authenticated routes are rate-limited per user (`429 RATE_LIMITED`) — see docs/rest-api.md "Errors" and "Rate limits".

**2026-10-30:** every response carries `X-Request-Id` (your own `X-Request-Id` header is echoed back if it matches `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$`, else a fresh UUID — each request ships a disabled `X-Request-Id` header you can enable to correlate with API logs). A 5xx `message` is never the exception text — it is a fixed sentence per code (`AI_*`, `COVER_IMAGES_*`, `LINKEDIN_IMPORT_FAILED`, `DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE`) or a generic one per status. Slug-generating creates retry a lost slug race 3 times before `409 *_SLUG_TAKEN`.

variable.description: NestJS backend base URL (global prefix /v1). Docker/Coolify deploys: swap for the deployed origin.
Supabase JWT access_token used as the Bearer token. Get one from the "Sign In" request below, or paste one from the frontend (localStorage / Application tab) while signed in.
Matches NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_URL. Only used by the Auth (Supabase) folder to mint a token — the backend itself is never called with this.
Matches NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. Safe to expose client-side; only used by the Auth (Supabase) folder.
Credentials for an existing Supabase user in your project, used by the Sign In request.
A second services.id, for multi-select examples (service preferences, article services).
An ai_draft_generations.id — the `generationId` from POST /articles/ai-draft, or an `id` from GET /admin/ai-generations.
A member_profiles.id (UUID) — owner-only write routes key on this, not the slug.
A member_profiles.slug — the public GET /members/:slug route keys on this.

item.name: POST /auth/v1/token — Sign in (password grant), mint a real JWT for every other request

request.description: Calls Supabase directly (NOT the GrowXQ backend) to exchange email/password for a JWT. Requires an existing user in your Supabase project (sign up via the frontend first, or use the Supabase dashboard). On success, the test script below auto-saves `access_token`/`refresh_token` into this environment’s `accessToken`/`refreshToken` variables, so every other request’s inherited Bearer auth picks it up immediately — no copy/paste needed.

exec: console.log('Saved accessToken to the active environment.');
console.warn('Sign-in failed — accessToken was not updated.');

item.name: POST /applications/me — Save or submit my application (upsert)

header.description: Optional. Echoed back in the X-Request-Id response header and API log lines; must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ or a UUID is generated instead.

request.description:
_client_ role only. Upsert: creates a draft on first call, merges fields on repeat calls. Every field optional — shown here mid-wizard with `status: "draft"`. Set `status: "submitted"` once every required field above is filled (see docs/rest-api.md) to trigger the full completeness check. Submitting requires a linked LinkedIn identity (`400 LINKEDIN_NOT_CONNECTED`); a save racing a submit/decision gets `409 APPLICATION_LOCKED`.

Rate limit (2026-10-30): own `application-save` bucket — 20/min, 60/hour, 200/day → `429 RATE_LIMITED`. `linkedinUrl` and `workExperiences[].companyUrl` must be http(s) → else `400 URL_INVALID`. Bounds (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED`): firstName/lastName ≤100, phoneCountryCode ≤10, phone ≤40, country/state/city ≤100, contactEmail ≤254, linkedinUrl/companyUrl ≤2048, couponCode ≤50, terms/privacyVersionAgreed ≤50, rateMin/MaxCents ≥0; workExperiences title/company ≤200, city ≤100, years 1900–2100; educations institution/degree/fieldOfStudy ≤200, years 1900–2100; peerReferences name/relationship ≤100, email ≤254, phone ≤40; servicePreferences[].customLabel ≤100. Other codes: `403 APPLICATION_CLIENTS_ONLY` · `409 APPLICATION_ALREADY_OPEN` · `400 RATE_RANGE_INVALID`, `COUPON_INVALID`, `SERVICE_PREFERENCES_DUPLICATE`, `SERVICE_IDS_INVALID`, `CUSTOM_SERVICE_LABEL_REQUIRED`, `APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE`, `WORK_HISTORY_END_BEFORE_START`.

```json

Analyzes the step-1 brief (notes/recentDevelopments/advice only — no service/country/state, those are AI-inferred later by ai-draft) and returns the minimum useful set of follow-up questions (0-10) — an empty array is a valid, expected result.

Errors (2026-10-30): `503 AI_NOT_CONFIGURED`, `502 AI_PROVIDER_ERROR`, `504 AI_TIMEOUT` (fixed client-safe `message` — branch on `code`). `429 RATE_LIMITED` (`ai` bucket).

header.description: Optional. Echoed back in the X-Request-Id response header and API log lines; must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ or a UUID is generated instead.

request.description:
member. `multipart/form-data` — NOT JSON. The `payload` field carries the AiDraftArticleRequest shape as a JSON **string**; `files` are optional source documents (PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, or TXT — DOCX is not supported). PDF/image uploads are sent to the model as native documents; TXT is embedded as prompt text. Every uploaded file is persisted to Storage for traceability. No title/serviceIds/countries/state in the request — the model infers all four, picking services/countries only from the real active lists, and returns them in the response for the member to review/correct. Response carries `generationId` — the id of this attempt's audit row; send it back as `aiGenerationId` on POST /articles so admins can trace the saved article to these inputs (GET /admin/ai-generations/{{aiGenerationId}}).

Errors (2026-10-30): `503 AI_NOT_CONFIGURED`, `502 AI_PROVIDER_ERROR`, `504 AI_TIMEOUT` (fixed client-safe `message` — branch on `code`). `429 RATE_LIMITED` (`ai-draft` bucket: 3/min, 20/hour, 50/day). The `payload` field is validated with whitelist + forbidNonWhitelisted: unknown keys → `400 AI_DRAFT_PAYLOAD_INVALID` (`message` array); valid JSON that is not an object → `400 AI_DRAFT_PAYLOAD_INVALID`; missing → `AI_DRAFT_PAYLOAD_MISSING`.

member (admin also passes). Omit `status` (or send anything other than 'draft') to submit — actual published/pending_review resolution is server-side via `ARTICLES_REVIEW_MODE`.

To save an article generated with POST /articles/ai-draft instead, add the draft's `generationId` to the body as `"aiGenerationId": "{{aiGenerationId}}"` (and `"creationMode": "ai"` — the server forces it anyway when aiGenerationId is set). It must be one of your own generations (400 otherwise); POST only, PATCH ignores the link.

Bounds (2026-10-30, `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, same on PATCH): serviceIds ≤20, countries ≤250 entries each ≤100 chars, state ≤100. `customServiceLabels` values must be text ≤100 (≤20 labels) → `400 CUSTOM_SERVICE_LABEL_INVALID`. Other codes: `ARTICLE_WORD_COUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE`, `SERVICE_IDS_INVALID`, `CUSTOM_SERVICE_LABEL_REQUIRED`, `AI_GENERATION_NOT_OWNER`.

header.description: Optional. Echoed back in the X-Request-Id response header and API log lines; must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ or a UUID is generated instead.

request.description:
🔒 Auth, any role. Keyed on slug, NOT the UUID. `404` if not found, not active, or a deactivated profile that isn’t the caller’s own.

Contact details (2026-10-30): `contactEmail`, `workEmail`, `contactPhone`, `linkedinUrl` are returned only to the owner, an admin with `manageMembers`, an active member, or a client with any consultation request to this member — everyone else gets `null` for those four. New field `contactVisible: boolean` says which (website/firmWebsite stay public). To check both sides, run this as a client before and after `POST /consultations`.

item.name: POST /members/{{memberId}}/uploads — Request a signed upload URL

header.description: Optional. Echoed back in the X-Request-Id response header and API log lines; must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ or a UUID is generated instead.

request.description: 🔒 member, owner-only (`:id` must equal caller id). Returns a signed URL — the member uploads directly to it; this endpoint never sees file bytes. `contentType` must be one of application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif (the bucket also caps uploads at 10MB); `fileName` ≤200 chars. Any file a later edit references is re-sniffed by magic bytes — `400 UPLOAD_INVALID_TYPE` / `UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE`.

header.description: Optional. Echoed back in the X-Request-Id response header and API log lines; must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ or a UUID is generated instead.

request.description:
🔒 member, owner-only. Creates a `pending` edit — never touches the live profile until admin approval. Shipped body is the `headline_bio` section (no proof needed). `section` can be any of: headline_bio, contact, engagements, education, work_experiences, key_clients, testimonials, awards — each has a different `payload` shape, see docs/rest-api.md / packages/shared-types/member.ts. `work_experiences`/`education` share one top-level proof (`proofFileUrl`) for the whole batch; engagements/testimonials/awards/key_clients carry proof per item instead. Any file path in a proof field must start with `{{memberId}}/` (where the upload endpoint puts them).

**To test work_experiences instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "section": "work_experiences",
  "payload": [
    {
      "title": "Principal Consultant",
      "company": "Reyes Tax Advisory",
      "startYear": 2015,
      "endYear": null,
      "isCurrent": true,
      "description": "Lead advisor for cross-border structuring engagements."
    }
  ],
  "proofFileUrl": "{{memberId}}/work-experience-proof.pdf"
}
```

**Updated 2026-10-10.** Proof is optional everywhere. Items may carry `id` (live item id when editing) — live items now return their `proofAttachments` so you can resend them. Server rules: engagements need `clientName` (+ optional `clientEmail`, `verificationMethods` from engagement_letter|client_deliverable|mail_confirmation_pdf|newsletter_transaction_update|other, `verificationMethodOther`); key_clients max 20; work_experiences may overlap (concurrent roles; stored newest-first; only end-before-start is rejected); contact accepts `workEmail`; testimonials accept optional `clientEmail` (2026-10-21). `clientEmail` on engagements/testimonials is only returned to the owner/admin.

**To test engagements instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "section": "engagements",
  "payload": [
    {
      "title": "Cross-border restructuring",
      "organization": "Acme Holdings",
      "clientName": "Jane Doe",
      "clientEmail": "jane@acme.example",
      "verificationMethods": ["engagement_letter", "other"],
      "verificationMethodOther": "Signed scope email",
      "year": 2024,
      "url": null,
      "proofAttachments": [{ "type": "link", "url": "https://example.com/letter.pdf", "label": "Engagement letter" }]
    }
  ]
}
```

**To test contact instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "section": "contact",
  "payload": {
    "contactEmail": "priya@example.com",
    "workEmail": "priya@firm.example.com",
    "contactPhone": "+65 5555 0100",
    "linkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/priya-menon",
    "website": null
  }
}
```

**To test testimonials instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "section": "testimonials",
  "payload": [
    {
      "quote": "Clear, practical advice on our Singapore holding structure.",
      "clientName": "Jane Doe",
      "clientTitle": "CFO",
      "clientCompany": "Acme Holdings",
      "clientEmail": "jane@acme.example",
      "serviceName": "International Tax",
      "occurredOn": "2026-03-01",
      "proofAttachments": []
    }
  ]
}
``` URL fields (contact.linkedinUrl/website, engagements[].url, key_clients[].logoUrl, link-type proofAttachments, proofLink) must be http(s) — anything else is `400 URL_INVALID`. Bounds: ≤50 items per array section, ≤10 proof attachments per item, ≤20 newly attached files per edit.

**Payload hardening (2026-10-30):** unknown keys in a payload/item are stripped (`isVerified` included); proofAttachments entries keep only {type,url,label}. `400 FIELD_TOO_LONG`: short text (title, organization, clientName, company, degree, institution, field, name, issuingBody, clientTitle, clientCompany, serviceName, occurredOn, id, logoUploadPath, headline) > 300; description/quote > 2000; bio > 5000; URLs > 2048; emails > 254; contactPhone > 50; proof url > 2048 / label > 300. `400 PAYLOAD_ITEM_INVALID`: a text field that is not a string/null, a number field (year, endYear, startYear, startMonth, endMonth) not a number/null, or a non-boolean isCurrent. key_clients: an item without a new `logoUploadPath` keeps the live item's logoUrl on approval; a client-sent `logoUrl` is ignored. `429 RATE_LIMITED` (`write` bucket).

```json

}

`rating` is `1` or `-1`; response `{ ok: true }`; scoped to your own question; feedback has its own limit of 30/min.

Each row is the FULL desired state of one event (replace, not patch) and the whole file is a full sync: blank `id` → create; filled `id` matching an existing event → replace every column except `slug`; any existing event whose id is absent from the file → **deleted**. header.description: Optional. Echoed back in the X-Request-Id response header and API log lines; must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ or a UUID is generated instead.

request.description:
🛡️ manageMembers. Shipped body is the per-item review for an array-section edit (engagements, education, work_experiences, key_clients, testimonials, awards): `items` must cover every payload index exactly once. Decisions: `approved_verified` (live WITH Verified badge; item must have proof, else 400 VERIFIED_REQUIRES_PROOF), `approved_hygiene` (live WITHOUT badge; `reason` required, shown to member), `rejected` (not applied; `reason` required). `status` is derived (verified if any item accepted) — omit it. Accepted items go live, rejected items are dropped (a live item stays as-is); decisions are stored in `itemReviews`.

**To review a headline_bio / contact edit (or approve the whole edit) instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "status": "verified"
}
```

**To reject the whole edit instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "status": "rejected",
  "reviewNote": "Please attach a proof document for this engagement before resubmitting."
}
```

2026-10-30: a key-client logo over 2MB fails with `400 LOGO_TOO_LARGE` from storage metadata, before download (`LOGO_INVALID_TYPE` for a non-image). Approved key_clients without a new upload keep the live logoUrl.
